svg.title: Identification bounds
svg.desc: Identification bounds. Four descriptive bounds for fixed baseline cells (No record or grade below expected level, historical 2005–2015; No record or grade below expected level, modern 2016–2024; Actual non-enrollment, historical 2005–2015; Actual non-enrollment, modern 2016–2023), percentage points; endpoints are identification limits, not confidence intervals or point estimates. The population includes students before missing outcomes are excluded and need not match the primary sample. Progression bounds unknown-grade success or failure; actual non-enrollment bounds true participation, which differs from no observed record. Historical and modern definitions differ; do not join endpoints as a causal series.
